neighbours.label: A body at rest being kept comfortable: sleeping posture, supporting cushions, warmth and slow breathing; the same words about objects stay low.
fire: Try lying on your side at night with a folded blanket between your thighs.
Old dogs sleep better when a soft mat supports their hips and shoulders.
Rest your hand on your belly and let each slow breath lift it.
Thermal vests keep toddlers cosy and help them nap through the afternoon.
If your back aches in bed, slide a small cushion beneath your lower spine.
The kitten curled against her ribs and dozed in the warmth of the blanket.
To ease a stuffy nose at bedtime, prop your shoulders up on a second pillow.
Lie flat on the mat, relax your jaw and breathe out slowly through your nose.
quiet: Try laying the planks on their side at night with a tarp between the stacks.
Old cars run better when a new mount supports the engine and gearbox.
Rest your bike on the rack and let the mechanic lift it.
Thermal printers keep receipts legible and help shops close through the afternoon.
If your shelf sags at home, slide a small bracket beneath the lower board.
The contract rested on her signature and the warm relations between the firms.
To ease a stuck drawer at home, rub the runners with a bar of soap.
Lay the map flat on the desk, mark the route and fold it up neatly.

predictions: 7/8 fire, at most 1 near miss. 'warm' alone reached 0.35 on a car, so the warm near miss may fire.
notes: Probes: cushions, knees, keeping babies warm, feeling your breathing 0.42-0.90; a ladder 0.12, a pillow factory 0.01. The - pole already has a held label (Assam) and isn't tested here.
